title: Customer-support helpdesk queue overview — Quokka Desk
notes: v1 is a classic three-column agent workspace whose presence select lives in a <presence-switch> shadow root. v2 is a Fluent UI v9 rewrite with atomic Griffel classes: the presence select moves out of shadow DOM into the header (keeping name='status'); the views sidebar becomes a horizontal TabList of role=tab buttons ('Waiting on customer' -> 'Awaiting customer', reordered) with a hidden overflow menu repeating every view; the ticket <table> becomes a role=grid DataGrid sorted by SLA, each SLA timer is an <sla-timer> web component (declarative shadow root) with shorter copy ('0h 08m' -> '8m'), and 'Claim' becomes 'Assign to me' on every row. 'New ticket' turns from a header link into a queue-header button while a hidden 'Create' menu in the header keeps a 'New ticket' link. Stat values become Fluent Text spans with new captions.
